summary: Change all five sidearms and their Quartermaster copies from 1d6 to 2d6 base damage and update the matching description statistics.

items.description:
A blackened dueling pistol engraved “Ad Hominem.”

Weapon Statistics

Level: 10   Rarity: Uncommon   Price: 5,000 gp
Weapon: Flintlock Pistol +2   Hands: One
Enhancement: +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls
Proficiency: +2   Damage: 2d6   Range: 10/20 squares
Weight: 2 lb.   Capacity: One shot
Weapon Properties: Brutal 2, High Crit, Off-Hand, Load Standard
Group: Firearm; uses hand-crossbow proficiency equivalence.

Critical: +2d6 damage, in addition to high crit.

Magic Property

Attacks with this pistol ignore the penalty for an enemy adjacent to your target.

Powers

Encounter Power

Action: Free Action

After you hit a creature with this pistol, it cannot make opportunity attacks until the end of your next turn.

Daily Power

Action: Immediate Interrupt

Trigger: An enemy you can see within 10 squares hits you with an attack. Effect: You can draw this pistol as part of this action, then make a ranged basic attack against the triggering enemy. If you hit, impose a -4 penalty on the triggering attack roll. The pistol must be loaded, and you must have a hand available to wield it; drawing it does not reload it.

A brass pistol whose firegem burns like a tiny gas lamp. Its bullets leave trails of warm amber light.

Weapon Statistics

Level: 10   Rarity: Uncommon   Price: 5,000 gp
Weapon: Flintlock Pistol +2   Hands: One
Enhancement: +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls
Proficiency: +2   Damage: 2d6   Range: 10/20 squares
Weight: 2 lb.   Capacity: One shot
Weapon Properties: Brutal 2, High Crit, Off-Hand, Load Standard
Group: Firearm; uses hand-crossbow proficiency equivalence.

Critical: +2d6 fire damage, in addition to high crit.

Magic Property

You can make the pistol shed bright light within 5 squares. Its attacks can deal fire damage instead of untyped damage.

Powers

Encounter Power

Action: Free Action

When you hit with this pistol, illuminate the target until the end of your next turn. It cannot benefit from concealment or invisibility during that time.

Daily Power

Action: Free Action

When you hit with this pistol, the target takes ongoing 5 fire damage (save ends). Until that damage ends, it sheds bright light within 5 squares.

A battered iron pistol hung with cheap votive charms. Its report sounds oddly like a distant chapel bell.

Weapon Statistics

Level: 10   Rarity: Uncommon   Price: 5,000 gp
Weapon: Flintlock Pistol +2   Hands: One
Enhancement: +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls
Proficiency: +2   Damage: 2d6   Range: 10/20 squares
Weight: 2 lb.   Capacity: One shot
Weapon Properties: Brutal 2, High Crit, Off-Hand, Load Standard
Group: Firearm; uses hand-crossbow proficiency equivalence.

Critical: +2d6 radiant damage, in addition to high crit.

Magic Property

While you are bloodied, gain a +2 item bonus to damage rolls with this pistol.

Powers

Encounter Power

Action: Free Action

When you hit with this pistol, one ally adjacent to the target can shift 1 square and gains 5 temporary hit points.

Daily Power

Action: Free Action

When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with this pistol, you or an ally within 5 squares can spend a healing surge.

A theatrical pistol with a crimson grip and a gold comedy mask on its hammer. Its report ends in scattered applause.

Weapon Statistics

Level: 10   Rarity: Uncommon   Price: 5,000 gp
Weapon: Flintlock Pistol +2   Hands: One
Enhancement: +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls
Proficiency: +2   Damage: 2d6   Range: 10/20 squares
Weight: 2 lb.   Capacity: One shot
Weapon Properties: Brutal 2, High Crit, Off-Hand, Load Standard
Group: Firearm; uses hand-crossbow proficiency equivalence.

Critical: +2d6 thunder damage, in addition to high crit.

Magic Property

Gain a +2 item bonus to Bluff checks while carrying it.

Powers

Encounter Power

Action: Free Action

When you hit with this pistol, slide the target 1 square. One ally who can see you can then shift 1 square.

Daily Power

Action: Free Action

When you score a critical hit or reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with this pistol, each ally within 5 squares gains 5 temporary hit points and can shift up to 2 squares.

A tarnished silver pistol with a copper coin set into its grip. Its barrel smells of river water.

Weapon Statistics

Level: 10   Rarity: Uncommon   Price: 5,000 gp
Weapon: Flintlock Pistol +2   Hands: One
Enhancement: +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls
Proficiency: +2   Damage: 2d6   Range: 10/20 squares
Weight: 2 lb.   Capacity: One shot
Weapon Properties: Brutal 2, High Crit, Off-Hand, Load Standard
Group: Firearm; uses hand-crossbow proficiency equivalence.

Critical: +2d6 cold damage, in addition to high crit.

Magic Property

While wielding it, gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against being slowed, immobilized, or restrained.

Powers

Encounter Power

Action: Free Action

When you hit with this pistol, teleport one willing ally adjacent to the target to an unoccupied square adjacent to you.

Daily Power

Action: Free Action

When you hit with this pistol, you and one willing ally within 5 squares can exchange positions by teleportation. You each gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
